headline: Treasury Sanctioned Whales Shipping Line. Its Company Profile Still Names Its Staff.

mainEntity.name: What is Whales Shipping Line LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Dubai shipping agency, licensed since 2013, that Treasury sanctioned on October 21, 2026, for supporting Amigoz Singapore Pte. Ltd. Treasury says it acted as the shipping agent for Sparrow Trading FZE.
WHALES DIAMOND (IMO 9375032) and WHALES PEARL (IMO 9483114), two UAE-flagged crew and supply boats. Whales Star and Whales Ruby, also on the company’s fleet page, are not.
No. OFAC’s entry for Whales names no individuals, and no Whales staff member is on OFAC’s list.

mainEntity.name: Is Whales connected to Karnakis and Karnakis?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in any OFAC or Treasury document. Both were sanctioned on the same day, but OFAC links Whales only to Amigoz Singapore.

mainEntity.name: Why does WHALES DIAMOND’s MMSI differ from OFAC’s?

acceptedAnswer.text: The boat broadcasts MMSI 470530000, while OFAC lists 470132000, which another vessel now uses. That pattern suggests re-registration, but it is unconfirmed.
